introHtml: Eddie Bauer fleece jackets and vests combine outdoor durability with a professional look, making them a top choice for corporate apparel programs. When you choose custom Eddie Bauer products for your team, you get reliable cold-weather gear that employees actually want to wear. Decorate the chest or back with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a polished finish that lasts through seasons of use.
